findings.claim: Subscription callback now unconditionally bumps a version counter, forcing a re-render on every store notification even when the snapshot is unchanged.
findings.rationale: Previously the callback did setState(getSnapshot()), which lets the state setter bail out when the value is unchanged; React's useSyncExternalStore likewise compares Object.is(prev, getSnapshot()) before re-rendering. The new `update = () => setVersion(v => v + 1)` always changes state, so any store emit (including ones for unrelated slices, which is common with selectors) re-renders every subscriber. The callback should compare latestSnapshot.current[0] against latestSnapshot.current[1]() and only call setVersion when they differ, as the mount/resubscribe path already does.
